text: This report is filed regarding suspicious activity in the account of Aiman Saeed (CNIC 479141-5557472-5), a freelance software developer with a declared monthly income of PKR 90,000. Between June 4 and June 12, 2026, the account received 14 inbound IBFT transfers totaling PKR 774,000 from 11 distinct counterparties, including Waqas Saeed, Junaid Naveed, and Arslan Butt. This volume is significantly inconsistent with the customer's declared income and occupation. The activity exhibits classic mule characteristics: funds were rapidly swept out of the account via two large outgoing transfers to a QuickPay wallet (PKR 137,000 on June 11 and PKR 112,000 on June 13) and one ATM withdrawal of PKR 148,000 at an ATM in Islamabad on June 12. The customer resides in Karachi, making the cash withdrawal in Islamabad geographically anomalous. The pattern of receiving numerous small-to-medium transfers from unrelated individuals and immediately moving the aggregate value to a digital wallet or cash suggests the account is being used to layer illicit funds. No legitimate business rationale for this flow has been provided.
